a.xlink:title: Public umbrella include for the OCTOSPI subsystem.

Configures the DMA-driven specialized OCTOSPI port implementation.
Shared policy of the interrupt-driven OCTOSPI modes ("IT" and "DMA").
Configures the Interrupt-driven specialized OCTOSPI port implementation.
Defines the transfer mechanism a HAL peripheral port uses for its transfers.

Checks whether a buffer lives in memory the DMA controllers can reach.
Shared open and close lifecycle of the interrupt-driven peripheral ports.
